official_github_sources.title: GitHub Actions billing
official_github_sources.finding: Standard GitHub-hosted runners are free for public repositories; larger runners are charged; artifact storage has plan-dependent included allowance and billed overage.

official_github_sources.title: GitHub-hosted runners reference
official_github_sources.finding: Public standard ubuntu-latest/ubuntu-24.04: 4 CPU, 16 GB RAM, 14 GB SSD; use is free and unlimited on public repositories.

official_github_sources.title: Workflow syntax
official_github_sources.finding: jobs.<job_id>.timeout-minutes defaults to 360 minutes; runner execution limit can cap earlier.

official_github_sources.title: Product usage included with each plan
official_github_sources.finding: Actions artifact storage allowance is plan-dependent and separate from public standard-runner minute pricing.
